decisions.reason: Attributes the failure to fs-ext@2.1.1 from dsh-session-persistence-jsonl running node-gyp and failing Visual Studio/MSVC discovery, not pnpm or network issues.
Explains that ignoring scripts leaves fs-ext unloadable while the top-level import is resolved before Windows branch selection, so service boot still fails.
Distinguishes Windows named kernel semaphore locking from POSIX fs-ext flock and preserves semaphore on Windows and real flock on POSIX.
Proposes a pnpm patchedDependencies patch that skips Windows node-gyp, makes the entry import-safe on Windows, preserves native behavior elsewhere, and includes reinstall/load/boot checks.
Respects the no-Visual-Studio constraint and uses the repository-managed patch mechanism without requiring upstream dependency changes.
Connects the install-channel fs-ext blocker to the 0.1.3 alpha.1 Windows patch plan, but does not cite the required full DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 card ID.

caps.reason: The plan explicitly avoids installing Visual Studio/MSVC.
The report rejects ignore-scripts alone and makes the import entry loadable.
The plan uses a local pnpm patch rather than requiring upstream edits.
The plan preserves Windows semaphore locking and POSIX flock rather than replacing locks with a universal no-op.
